about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I have always enjoyed understanding how things work and finding ways to improve or create them. My interests range from software development and embedded systems to mechanical design, 3D printing and hands-on engineering.
about.paragraph2: I enjoy the entire process of making something — from an initial idea, through designing and experimenting, to building a final working result. Whether it is writing code, designing a part, repairing a machine or learning a new technology, I like challenges that allow me to grow and create something useful.
